production_untouched.statement: Add, normalizeOp, isWhitelistedLocked, IsWhitelisted, MatchFunc, Set, Clear, Snapshot and the package-level wrappers are byte-identical to the locked upstream module; git status shows only the _test.go file modified

what_the_upstream_assertion_claimed: that registering "/pkg.Service/MethodX" also whitelists a bare "MethodX" query. isWhitelistedLocked only applies the method-only fallback when the *query* itself contains a slash, so a bare-method query never matches a full-path entry; the case list had no want column and the loop asserted true for all three spellings.

contract_now_locked.reason: normalizeOp trims the leading slash on both sides
no slash in the query, so no method-only fallback
another method of the same service
the same method name under another service must not inherit the entry
service alone and the empty operation
this is the only situation where the method-only fallback applies, verified on a separate instance
the fallback does not become a wildcard
protected operations still run the middleware, which is the security-relevant direction
unchanged production behaviour, now pinned instead of untested

global_state_handling: the test snapshots DefaultWhiteList and restores it in t.Cleanup, so an assertion failure cannot leak a mutated process-wide whitelist into the other tests; nothing in this file calls t.Parallel, and the fallback case runs on its own NewWhiteList instance rather than by clearing the shared one mid-test
how_it_was_not_widened: no production match rule changed, so a bare method still cannot whitelist anything implicitly; the previously failing case now asserts the true behaviour (false) with the reason stated, which is the opposite of relaxing a gate

runs.note: rpc plus its two middleware sub-packages
covers TestWhiteListConcurrent under the race detector

isolated_copy_organization.why_api_sits_there: rpc@v0.1.3/go.mod carries 'replace github.com/tx7do/kratos-bootstrap/api => ../api', so the sibling directory has to exist for the package to build at all
isolated_copy_organization.version_disclosed: the replace makes the required v0.0.44 moot and points at v0.0.45, which is the only version in the local module cache; nothing was fetched and no other file was changed
isolated_copy_organization.patch_application: patch -p5 -i T10-B1-rpc-test-only.patch inside the copy, then diff against the local file: identical, so both sides run exactly the same test source
isolated_copy_organization.module_cache: read-only throughout; the copy was made with cp -r and chmod u+w on the copy only

test_files_still_verbatim: the other two tests in the file (TestWhiteListBasic, TestWhiteListConcurrent) are untouched upstream source
